title: Pharmacy Benefit Plan Coordination of Benefits: Training Notes
content:
Training notes for member services on coordination of benefits (other coverage) under the Pharmacy Benefit Plan, set out as the rules and the questions they answer.

## Rules

1. A coordination-of-benefits questionnaire is sent every questionnaire interval of the design, in months. When it is not returned within the design's return period, in calendar days, of being sent, the cycle is recorded as not returned and claims pend for other-coverage review until the member answers.
2. A returned answer is recorded, and the enrollment's other-coverage status and other-coverage verified date are updated from it. An agent may also record an answer the member gives by phone.
3. When other coverage is primary, Northbridge Rx pays as secondary using the design's secondary-payer method. When the member is Medicare-primary for prescriptions, Northbridge Rx pays secondary to Part D.
4. Other coverage may be recorded only for an enrollment that is active, in COBRA continuation or in COBRA grace. The status is read from the enrollment record before the answer is recorded.

## Questions the rules answer

**Q. The member did not send back the questionnaire in time. What follows?**
A. The cycle is recorded as not returned, and the member's claims pend for other-coverage review until the member answers.

**Q. Can the member give the answer over the phone instead of on the form?**
A. Yes. An agent may record an answer the member gives by phone; the answer is recorded and the enrollment's other-coverage status and verified date are updated from it, as for a returned form.

**Q. What are the possible answers?**
A. The member reports no other coverage, or reports other coverage. A cycle with no answer within the return period is recorded as not returned.

**Q. The member is Medicare-primary for prescriptions. How does Northbridge Rx pay?**
A. Secondary to Part D.

## Recording other coverage by enrollment status

| Enrollment status | Other coverage may be recorded |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| COBRA continuation | Yes |
| COBRA grace | Yes |
| Pending effective | No |
| Terminated | No |

## Illustration (hypothetical dates, return period of 45 calendar days)

A questionnaire is sent on 1 February. With a return period of 45 calendar days, and in a year in which February has 28 days, the 45th day after 1 February is 18 March. If no answer has come back within that period, the cycle is recorded as not returned and claims pend for other-coverage review. When the member later calls and states they have no other coverage, the agent may record that answer; once it is recorded, the enrollment's other-coverage status and verified date are updated, and the member has answered.
